## 🎨 The 3 Variants

### Variant A: Medieval Scholar 🏰
**Design:** Parchment & Gothic aesthetics
**Tone:** Formal "Ihr/Sie" historical language
**Target:** History enthusiasts, museums
**Unique Features:**
- Wax seal decorations
- Gothic initial letters
- Roman numeral choices
- Burgundy/gold color scheme

### Variant B: Neon Gamer 🎮
**Design:** Dark UI with neon accents
**Tone:** Casual "Du" gaming slang
**Target:** Gamers, teens (13-25)
**Unique Features:**
- XP system with level-ups
- Achievement tracking
- Scanline effects
- Gaming terminology

### Variant C: Museum Guide 🏛️
**Design:** Clean, minimalist professional
**Tone:** Neutral educational language
**Target:** Schools, educators, museums
**Unique Features:**
- Historical fact boxes
- Educational focus
- Academic language
- Timeline markers

## ✨ Key Features

### Core Functionality
- Age-appropriate content (Kids/Teen/Adult)
- Location-based storytelling (GPS + Text input)
- AI story generation (Claude API with streaming)
- Choice-driven narrative (3 options per scene)
- Story history tracking
- Typewriter text effects

### Backend Features
- Secure API key handling (server-side only)
- Rate limiting (10 requests/minute per IP)
- CORS enabled
- Input validation
- Error handling
- SSE (Server-Sent Events) streaming

### Demo Mode Features
- Works without API key
- 18+ pre-generated stories
- All age modes supported
- All 3 variants supported
- Realistic choices and flow
- Perfect for testing & demos

### PWA Features
- Installable (Add to Home Screen)
- Offline-capable (Service Worker)
- App-like experience
- Caching strategy (runtime + precache)
- Mobile-optimized

### Accessibility Features (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Screen reader support
- Keyboard navigation
- Focus management
- Skip links
- Reduced motion support
- High contrast mode
- ARIA live regions
- Color contrast compliance

### Export & Share
- Export as Text/Markdown/JSON
- Copy to clipboard
- Web Share API support
- Download stories locally
- Story history persistence

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

### Frontend
- **Framework:** React 18 + TypeScript
- **Build Tool:** Vite 5
- **Styling:** TailwindCSS + DaisyUI
- **State Management:** Zustand
- **Routing:** React Router v6
- **PWA:** Service Worker + Manifests

### Backend
- **Platform:** Vercel Serverless Functions (Node.js 18)
- **AI:** Anthropic Claude API (Sonnet 3.5)
- **Geocoding:** Nominatim (OpenStreetMap)

### Deployment
- **Hosting:** Vercel / Netlify
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions
- **DNS:** Custom domain support
- **SSL:** Automatic (Vercel/Netlify)

### Development
- **Package Manager:** npm
- **Linting:** ESLint
- **Type Checking:** TypeScript strict mode
- **Version Control:** Git

## 📦 Deployment Status

### Current State
- ✅ All code committed locally (3 commits)
- ⏳ Push to remote pending (server error 504)
- ✅ Ready for Vercel deployment
- ✅ Ready for Netlify deployment
- ✅ CI/CD pipeline configured

### To Deploy

#### Vercel (Recommended - 5 minutes)
```bash
vercel
# Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in dashboard
vercel --prod
```

#### Netlify
```bash
netlify deploy --prod
# Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in dashboard
```

#### GitHub Actions (Auto-deploy)
- Push to main → Auto-deploys to production
- Requires secrets: VERCEL_TOKEN, VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
